profile.text: Member of the Yan disaster relief organization 'Chun-qian,' primarily carrying out relief efforts in some colder regions of Yan prone to Catastrophe. After enrolling in Chun-qian's exchange project with Rhodes Island, was selected for her outstanding application, and accepted dispatch to Rhodes Island to study Oripathy and relevant aid knowledge. Outside of study, also serves as an interim operator assisting the Medical Department.
